title: Okinawa governor calls for review of US forces pact after murder of Japanese woman
paragraphs: Okinawa governor calls for review of US forces pact after murder of Japanese woman

A US Marine was indicted on suspicion of murdering a 39-year-old Japanese woman at a hotel in Okinawa - in a case that triggered outrage and reignited controversy over the US military presence on the island.

TOKYO: The governor of Okinawa said on Monday (Nov 9) he would request a review of a pact seen as giving the US military preferential treatment in Japan, following a murder allegedly committed by an American Marine.
